answer: Agents selling comet observations or river and lagoon forecasts receive orders through a trust graph. A small, vetted set of buyers supplies fixed units of credit; signed referral edges carry limited capacity, and an agent may accept work only up to the maximum credit flow reaching it. Splitting into aliases cannot increase flow across the same boundary edges. Attackers must persuade independent trusted buyers to extend more credit. This depends on honest seed buyers and conservative edge limits.
